title: Interleave Image, State, and Text Tokens
summary: A language model can consume image, state and text embeddings in one sequence when they share a feature width.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Projected token features are dimensionless; IDs are indices, not physical channels.

physical_contract.axes: three source matrices(Ni/E,Ns/E,Nt/E), layout(L,2) -> tokens(L,E), modalities(L)
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: All source arrays belong to one caller-aligned observation context; ordering is supplied, not inferred from timestamps.
physical_contract.batching: three source matrices(Ni/E,Ns/E,Nt/E), layout(L,2) -> tokens(L,E), modalities(L)

provenance.authoring_notes: Original explicit interleaver motivated by PaLM-E embedding continuous observations into a language stream. It assumes the sensor projections and tokenizer already ran.
